header: Independent fsoil3d_candidate_r1 namespace cloned from current FunSoilMaterial core only. Explicit TpDPCtes in At/Evaluate/Return; original DP_PS expression/order retained, DP_C/DP_MC use original primary Eq12b/12c double coefficients and cohesion/dilation derivatives. Eight float parameters, float saved kappa and local double return remain. No native adapters, phi softening, apex/cap, GPU/spatial admission or implicit seepage/material switch. Return rejects invalid fit before internal At/Evaluate calls.
probe_scope: 41 material rows: 21 ordinary radial,12 elastic/unload,3 ApexNeeded,5 Invalid. Three fits and psi0/+2.5/-5; constant-strength and cohesion+dilation decay at oldkappa.5, plus one initial-history radial per fit. All ordinary trials have six nonzero stress components. No solver,time-step or half chain.

checks.DP_PS_current_core: 14 cases: every named state/result scalar, status and iterations must match current fsoil::Return exactly, including failed-state NaN scalar bits. No POD-padding comparison.
checks.new_kappa_yield: Independent invariant formula uses principal-stress differences; yield evaluated at continuous root history must satisfy original4*root_budget. Saved-float kappa yield and its difference are exported separately, without a new physical Pa gate.
checks.original_arithmetic_budgets: Tensor q/I and constant-rotation error8192eps*max(1,|Itrial|,qtrial,|Inew|,qnew); dev history and plastic trace8192eps absolute because current declared strain increments are below1; constant-strength closed multiplier4096eps. Positive consistency, unchanged failures and exact float(kcontinuous) storage remain required.
checks.rotation: Nine constant-strength cases use a proper non-axis 3-D quaternion-derived orthogonal matrix, with all xy/yz/xz exercised. Nonlinear softening rotation is not silently assigned the tighter constant-strength budget.
checks.derivatives: Fourteen three-dimensional radial cases independently central-difference fixed-stress f(k),beta(k),and F(lambda). Fixed h_k=1e-5; h_lambda=min(1e-7,one-quarter distance to radial endpoints). Budgets are analytic third-derivative truncation plus16eps propagated evaluation/subtraction error, set in source before execution. Dpsi>=2 gives |beta_psi'|<.867,|beta_psi''|<1.733,|beta_psi'''|<4.764; chain-rule bounds include actual sf and maximum|psi| in the increment interval. No pressure/half-step limit is reused.
checks.legacy_observations: Only two psi0/kappa.5 softening examples, one DP_C and one DP_MC, call actual linked UpdateDPvars/Updatedfdk. Float and1.732 differences are recorded, never forced to double equality or treated as new solver accuracy.
checks.unsupported: Hydrostatic tensile apex and invalid shear/NaN/fit return unchanged state. NonConverged has no natural witness in this bounded set; report uncovered rather than force one.

candidate_build.execution_record: After code full-read, one CL/link and one direct material target using existing lean owned-tool recipe. Seal actual Popen/Win32 exits before result checks, preserve first failure, no automatic retry. Stat binding only; no SHA/archive sweep. This note does not execute any tool.
candidate_build.outputs: points.csv with named inputs/returned tensor,continuous/saved history,yield/compliance/rotation/derivative ratios and two marked legacy observations; completion.json only after all declared checks pass.

acceptance_boundary: CPU candidate algebraic milestone only. Old default and frozen r2 delivery are unchanged. Subsequent GPU actual adapters/PreCor and ordinary 3-D scope remain later implementation stages; no claim of3-D u-pl,mDBC,plastic HG,restart,spatial convergence or collapse acceptance.
